lineup.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Codematica character design lineup, a single landscape model-sheet artwork.
Input image 1 is the identity and style reference for Patch, our existing mascot. Preserve that robot's rounded cream enamel shell, deep teal glass face, two warm amber light eyes, orange circular ear caps, short ball-tipped antenna, compact belly, articulated dark joints, orange shoulder pads, sturdy small boots and pincer hands. Refine the silhouette and restrained chipped-paint details; keep its friendly, practical repair-robot personality. Do not substitute a different robot.
Create a cohesive full-body lineup of exactly FOUR ORIGINAL characters, evenly spaced, entirely visible with generous padding on a pale warm paper background:
1. PATCH, a friendly compact maintenance robot based closely on the reference, front three-quarter view, one open pincer in a small greeting.
2. SHAMBLER, a slow moss-green zombie with a large rounded head, uneven sleepy eyes, one tiny square tooth, floppy sage/teal patched work jacket and muted ochre scarf, broad mitten-like hands and squat worn boots.
3. RUNNER, a lean mint/olive zombie with a narrower head, lively asymmetrical eyes, cropped swept-back tuft, a rust-orange hooded work vest, dark teal shorts and chunky little running shoes; bent forward springy pose.
4. ARMORED, a stocky olive-green zombie wearing a dented cream enamel maintenance helmet with an orange stripe and mismatched cream/orange salvaged chest armor over dark teal workwear; face clearly visible, broad boots, heavy but endearing silhouette.
All four must belong to the same illustrated world: softly modeled 2.5D painterly forms, subtle ink contours, tactile matte enamel/canvas, gentle material wear, cream + teal + ochre/orange accents, soft warm light from upper left, simple expressive faces. Zombies are playful undead opponents, not robots, not humans in costume. Friendly spooky tone, no blood, wounds, bones or gore. Preserve distinct silhouettes and readable facial features at game scale. Avoid flat geometric placeholder art, shiny plastic 3D, photorealism, excessive tiny detail, copied game characters and weapons.
Add only small tasteful labels beneath each figure: PATCH, SHAMBLER, RUNNER, ARMORED. No other text, no logo, no watermark. Canvas 1536x1024 landscape.

portraits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: individual square character portrait thumbnail for Codematica, polished final artwork, 1024x1024.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED character identity/style reference, a lineup. Create ONLY PATCH, the robot on the far LEFT. Keep its rounded cream enamel head, dark teal glass face, two vertical glowing amber eyes, orange round ear discs and short orange ball antenna. Warm, curious expression through eye tilt, compact upper torso with cream belly hatch and orange fittings; show just a small waving pincer at the lower edge. Robot with no human features.
Preserve exactly the reference character identity, proportions, palette, clothing and gently weathered materials. Soft painterly 2.5D modeling with delicate dark ink contours and light enamel/canvas texture, warm upper-left light, charming and readable, no gore.
Composition: one centered bust portrait from the upper chest up, in a gentle three-quarter view toward the viewer. Large face occupies most of the square, with the full head, ears, hair/helmet and antenna retained and at least 8% breathing room around the silhouette. Only the chest may be cropped by the lower edge. Both eyes clearly visible. Strong readable silhouette and expressive eyes at 64 pixels; simplify micro-scratches. Keep lighting and camera distance consistent with a collectible character portrait family.
Background: soft dusty teal fading gently toward warm pale sage; flat quiet full-bleed painted color field with a subtle light halo behind the head, no scenery and no separate decorative border. Opaque square artwork suitable for square, rounded-square or circular thumbnail masks. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, UI, extra characters or extra limbs. Do not render the whole lineup or a contact sheet.
